rig.name: Mudhoney - Touch Me I'm Sick - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up excessive noise inherent in aggressive fuzz tones.
Provide initial grit and midrange punch before the main fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here to simulate a dirty, aggressive boost/overdrive characteristic of garage rock, rather than its typical clean use.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core buzzy, aggressive fuzz tone required for garage punk.
Included as a placeholder/option; kept inactive to avoid the 'wah' sound explicitly avoided by the source.
blocks.gap: The T-Wah is included but disabled, fulfilling the requirement for a WAH module while adhering to the 'avoid wah' instruction.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a dirty British combo amp for raw power and aggressive midrange bite.
Provide a dry, close-mic sound that emphasizes the raw punch and midrange of the fuzz.
Sculpt the tone by cutting excessive low end and boosting the nasty midrange bite.
Included as a placeholder; kept inactive to maintain the raw, dry garage sound.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is included but disabled, fulfilling the requirement for a MOD module while adhering to the 'raw/dry' instruction.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal, natural ambience to prevent the tone from sounding completely sterile.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is used sparingly (low mix) to maintain rawness while providing necessary depth.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance the raw, close-mic garage punk sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance grit and natural room interaction for raw garage tone.
